- Tue 10/27, 9:30–9:45am
- Wed 10/28, 2:00–2:15pm

If none of those work, here's a one-click calendar link to pick any 15-min window: https://cal.com/ben/redwood-15min

I've attached a one-page agenda and a high-level proposal so you can share with the procurement folks if helpful.

Thanks — Ben
